currentPersistence.identity: PRIMARY KEY(scan_date,symbol) in current archive lineage
sequence: await one INSERT ... ON CONFLICT UPDATE per row
currentPersistence.callerBehavior: Research write is fail-open; exceptions are caught into shadowArchiveSave error and Formal continues.
currentPersistence.sameDateRerun: A later persistence for the same scan_date replaces the earlier captured archive; first-known generation/fingerprint is not retained.

failureModes.witness: Same scan_date A is saved, later rerun produces archive B. DELETE(A-date)+insert(B) removes A evidence.
failureModes.impact: Current table cannot prove first-known cohort membership/provenance for that date.

failureModes.witness: Existing complete date is deleted; insert loop succeeds for early rows then throws before all rows are written.
failureModes.impact: A complete prior archive can become a partial archive. No explicit transaction/batch was found around the sequence.

failureModes.currentIntegrityResult: HEALTHY is possible because current governance checks only total>0, SELECTED count equality and BROAD_CONTROL presence.
failureModes.impact: HEALTHY means minimum archive presence, not complete expected population/sample receipt.

failureModes.currentIntegrityResult: HEALTHY is possible even if every other expected research population/sample failed to persist.
failureModes.impact: Zero-pick dates are particularly vulnerable to false completeness if only a broad-control row remains.

interpretationGuard: Existing shadow integrity status must be read as MINIMUM_PRESENCE_HEALTH, not archive completeness.
Current created_at/updated_at cannot reconstruct a deleted prior same-date generation.
A successful current read does not prove no earlier partial/mutating write occurred.
Do not use same-date replay as promotion-grade first-known evidence without immutable generation/fingerprint receipts.
requiredRepair: Never delete first-known evidence before durable replacement is validated.
Use insert-once immutable receipt generations with semantic fingerprint; same identity/same fingerprint idempotent, different fingerprint PROVENANCE_CONFLICT.
Persist expected row/population denominator receipt before or atomically with membership rows.
A completeness receipt must compare expected vs persisted counts by receipt/membership family and pool, not only SELECTED/BROAD_CONTROL presence.
Record capture generation / captured_at / formal worker version / comparator version / source quality state.
Historical current-table rows remain legacy mutable evidence and require LEGACY_MUTABLE_ARCHIVE quality state; do not silently promote them to immutable.
